description: Small synthetic smoke evaluation, not a production benchmark. Expected labels are hand-written and include different wording plus nearby distractors.

passages.text: GPU parallelism. Graphics processors use many arithmetic lanes to apply matrix operations to batches of data at the same time.
GPU memory bandwidth. Computation can stall while data moves from device memory to arithmetic units; increasing bandwidth feeds the processor.
Bread fermentation. Yeast consumes sugars and produces carbon dioxide, forming gas bubbles that make dough rise.
Database B-tree indexes. A branching search tree narrows a SQL lookup to a small range instead of scanning every table row.
Federated sign-in. An identity provider authenticates a person and issues a signed token that a backend verifies before granting access.
Camera exposure. Aperture controls incoming light and depth of field; shutter duration affects motion blur; sensor sensitivity affects noise.
Semantic vector search. Text embeddings represent meaning so nearest-neighbor distance can retrieve related passages despite different vocabulary.
Hierarchical SQL queries. A recursive common table expression follows parent-child edges to find ancestors or descendants across several levels.
